action.edit: Edit gear, flaps and light events
title: Events – {name}
state.title: State at playhead ({time})
state.none: No gear, flaps or light events yet.
add.title: Add at playhead ({time})
sel.title: Selected event
sel.none: Tap an event on the timeline or in the list to select it. Drag it to move it.
sel.flapsRange: Flaps position of the selected event
list.title: All events
list.empty: No events on this track yet.
ground.label: Force on ground
ground.hint: Marks every position as on the ground, for hiking or car tracks. Unchecked, the flags stay as imported.
toast.same: The track already is in that state at this point, so there is nothing to add.
toast.occupied: There already is an event of this kind at exactly this time.
help.title: Event editor – help
help.intro: Gear, flaps and each light are a series of changes. An event always has to change something, so a second "gear down" in a row cannot exist: it is refused when you add it, and events that become redundant are removed.
help.touch: Tap a marker on the timeline to select it and drag it to move it. Tap empty space in the track row to move the playhead there, then add an event at the playhead with the buttons in the panel.
help.earlier: Move the selected event 0.1 s earlier
help.later: Move the selected event 0.1 s later
help.earlier1: Move the selected event 1 s earlier
help.later1: Move the selected event 1 s later
